item.title: Giri☆Giri Sisters
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Re:verse
  • 発売日: 2008-07-18
  • スコア: 5.83/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 義理☆ギリ しすたぁ～ず
  • 英語名: Giri☆Giri Sisters

别名

  • sisters-in-law

あらすじ

Family Planning begun out of duty

Immediately after beginning to live on his own, the protagonist Kaoru’s home is destroyed in a fire.

Gazing, dumbfound, as his apartment goes up in flames, someone calls out to him.

“Um, excuse me?”

He turns towards the voice with a sullen expression on his face, only to find himself looking at his dead mother….

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Re:verse
  • 発売日: 2008-02-22
  • スコア: 5.82/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Master Of Erotology ～先っちょが精イッパイ～
  • 英語名: Master Of Erotology Sakiccho ga Seiippai

别名

  • Master Of Erotology - bell-end is all I can do -

あらすじ

In accordance with his last will and testament, Chiaki’s father leaves his entire fortune to Chiaki, his one and only son, and in just one day Chiaki becomes the very rich owner of a mansion.

And just what will become of his life and the lives of the maids he meets who are still in mid-development… ?
